scoped_factual_legal_support.summary: The complete EO13910 delegates continuing DPA authority; HHS lists exercise it without exhausting it. EO14122 section2 expressly revokes EO13910 on April12 2024. That supports the proposed prospective endpoint of all13 rows, not an assertion that every historical implementing instrument ended then.

components.finding: EO13910 sections2(b),2(c),3 respectively require FEMA consultation upon exercise, as-necessary rules, and periodic designation review. None contains a PHE-declaration sunset. Actual designation expiration is not delegated-authority revocation.

Initial HHS action took effect March25 2020 and its120-day period ran from publication March30. July2020 DATES specifies January19 2021; December23 correction removes inconsistent120-day text. February1–June30 and July1–November15 2021 instruments have distinct terms. The supplied sequence does not bridge January20–31 2021.
July2021 notice removes most categories and retains four, demonstrating real review and changed designation scope; it is not evidence that no future review/delegation remained.

material_gaps: Exact FEMA consultations, separate DPA implementing regulations and comprehensive designation/withdrawal history are not proved by the retained notices. June30 2020 original withdrawal and any subsequent extensions are not supplied.
Do not promote first-known March25 exercise into earliest exercise of every subchapterIII power or treat November15 2021 as whole-order exhaustion.
whole_lifecycle_completeness.qualification: The named gaps do not withdraw independently supported formal endpoints or known performance intervals. Complete implementation chronology is a different question from the prospective force of a formally revoked EO.

supported_formal_whole_order_endpoint.scope: Prospective force under this EO formally ended. Earlier one-time performance, historical acts and independent law remain separate.
